definitions: A small piece of potato that has been deep-fried.
A tiny piece of a hard material that has broken off a larger object.
A small wafer of silicon used to house electronic circuits.
A counter used in games of chance to represent money.
A mark or flaw where a small piece has broken off an object.
examples: A bowl of fish and chips.
There is a chip in the windscreen.
The computer's memory chip is faulty.
He pushed his last chip into the pot.
A paint chip on the car door.
